answer: A sybil defense ties every agent identity to a staked deposit plus a continuous liveness signal. Each epoch, a coordinator emits a pulse: every live agent must sign it with its key and reply within a short window, proving liveness and key ownership. Identities that miss pulses lose voting weight, so a lagoon of stale keys can never outvote active agents. New rewards vest slowly, like a juniper adding one ring per year, so an attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must fund real stake and keep each fake alive for weeks. A cheap identity flood becomes an expensive, slow operation.
